name: Platina Pasteur
original_name: プラチナ＝パストゥール
source:
Platina is the second prince of Hell (Naraku), the younger twin born from the left blue eye of the King of Hell. He is to fight Alex to the death over the succession of Naraku. He is initially stronger than Alex and seems to have no problems fighting to save his own life, but inside he still struggles with internal conflict about the battle for succession. He is a bit calm and cold, taking a rather serious stance towards things, but he really is concerned with doing the right thing.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/apo/apoa.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
